claim.quote: no evidence for a WIMP signal was found. For a WIMP mass of 29 GeV/c2, limits on the spin-dependent cross section on protons of sigma_p = 1.31 pb and on neutrons of sigma_n = 21.5 pb have been obtained at 90% C.L.

name: Improved Spin Dependent Limits from the PICASSO Dark Matter Search Experiment
notes: Date: first arXiv submission (v1, 15 Feb 2005); the abstract quoted is that of the latest arXiv version (v2, last revised 9 Aug 2005).

summary.plain: With a small exposure of droplet detectors in the SNO cavern, PICASSO found no sign of dark matter and set limits on how strongly a 29 GeV/c^2 WIMP could interact with protons and neutrons through spin.
summary.technical: Superheated C4F10 droplets, exposure 1.98 +- 0.19 kg d at 2070 m depth: sigma_p(SD) = 1.31 pb and sigma_n(SD) = 21.5 pb at 29 GeV/c^2 (90% C.L.), also expressed as limits on the effective couplings a_p and a_n.

title: Improved Spin Dependent Limits from the PICASSO Dark Matter Search Experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract states that some new parameter space at WIMP masses below 20 GeV/c2 was ruled out.
